standard.summary: 验证集评估时使用的随机种子，确保每次验证使用相同的随机状态（可重复比较）。
standard.effect: 固定 validation_seed 后，相同模型在验证集上的 loss 评估完全可重复，方便跨训练运行比较。
standard.whenToUse: 开启验证集评估（validate_every_n_steps）时设置，获得可重复的验证 loss。
standard.avoidWhen: 不使用验证集时此参数无意义。

standard_en.summary: The random seed used when evaluating on the validation set, which keeps every validation on the same random state (so comparisons repeat).
standard_en.effect: With validation_seed fixed, the same model's loss evaluation on the validation set is exactly reproducible, which makes comparing across training runs easy.
standard_en.whenToUse: Set it when validation-set evaluation is on (validate_every_n_steps), for a reproducible validation loss.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Meaningless when no validation set is used.
